> Full catenary: equating vertical components ${2T}_{Y} = 2T\sin \theta = W$

>

> Half catenary: equating horizontal components $T_{0} = T\cos \theta = \frac{W}{2\tan \theta}$

>

> Part: horizontal component of tension = $T_{0}$ constant; Vertical component = Weight of part length

>

> The slope of tangent keeps increasing with $x$
